idea-plugin.name: Change Case
idea-plugin.description:
Converts the selected text, or the word at the caret, to the next case format: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, SNAKE_CASE, kebab-case, space case and Title Case. Works with multiple carets.
Run it from Edit → Change Case or with Shift+Alt+U. Which formats are used, and in which order, is set in Settings → Editor → Change Case.

action.description: Convert the selection, or the word at the caret, to the next case format
